clue.text: Charge follows support that was primitive

indicators.note: the charge comes after the support, so its letters are placed second in the build

blocks.note: to back someone is to support them
a ward is a person in someone's charge

explanation.surface: Someone paying a fee for an old-fashioned kind of support, perhaps a crude prop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charge' looks like a fee or an attack; here it is a person in your care.
explanation.definitionFit: A backward society or tool is undeveloped, which is exactly what a primitive one is.

clue.text: Endorse a symbol

blocks.note: first meaning: to put your signature on a document
second meaning: a mark standing for something, like a plus or a road marker

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads like approving a logo; the two words are separate senses of one short word.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means writing your name in approval; as a noun it is a mark representing an idea.

clue.text: Protest in the open air ends in tears

blocks.note: being out means being outdoors
to be in tears is to cry

explanation.surface: An outdoor demonstration that finishes with the marchers weeping.
explanation.definitionFit: A public outcry is a loud collective objection, the noun sense of protest.

clue.text: Opens and reveals

blocks.note: first meaning: spreads out something that was creased together, like a map
second meaning: lets a story or plan become known gradually

explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers both physically spreading out a folded sheet and a narrative gradually coming to light.

clue.text: They say newspapers take a long time for forecasts

indicators.note: the newspapers take in, or hold, the long time, so one sits inside the other

blocks.note: the press is the newspapers collectively
an age is a very long time

explanation.surface: A grumble that the papers are slow to publish their predictions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'They say' is surface padding: forecasts are what papers say about the future. 'Take' looks like 'need', but it means hold inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Presages are signs or warnings of what is to come, so they are forecasts or omens.

clue.text: Give praise to an organisation for detachment

indicators.note: organising things means arranging them in a new order, so the words before it are rearranged

blocks.note: the ten letters are used as they stand

explanation.surface: A donor commending a charity for keeping its distance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Organisation' looks like the body receiving praise, but it is the signal to rearrange 'praise to an'.
explanation.definitionFit: Separation is the state of being apart or cut off, which is what detachment also names.

clue.text: A measure of drink (think about it!) will build strength

indicators.note: thinking about something wraps the thought around it, so the measure sits inside

blocks.note: to muse is to think or ponder
cl is the centilitre, a unit drinks are measured in

explanation.surface: Advice that a modest tot, taken thoughtfully, will make you strong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' points back to the measure of drink, which is what the thinking goes around.
explanation.definitionFit: Muscle is used for physical power or clout, as in having the muscle to do something, so it equals strength.

clue.text: It's understood vase is reserved

blocks.note: something tacit is understood without being said
an urn is a kind of vase

explanation.surface: It is accepted that a particular vase has been set aside for someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reserved' seems to mean booked for the vase; it is the definition, describing a quiet person.
explanation.definitionFit: A taciturn person says little, which is how a reserved, uncommunicative character behaves.

clue.text: Sad partly at failure to accrue full benefits

indicators.note: only part of the following words is wanted, so the answer is a run of letters inside them

blocks.note: the run starts after acc and stops before the final l

explanation.surface: Someone feeling a bit gloomy because they missed out on the complete benefits.
explanation.definitionFit: Rueful means expressing regret or sorrow, a mild form of being sad.

clue.text: Related to a family

blocks.note: taken as written
kin are your relatives, your family

explanation.surface: Being connected by blood to a particular household.
explanation.definitionFit: Akin means similar or of the same kind, originally meaning of the same blood.

clue.text: Mongrel on bed makes one angry

indicators.note: in a down-reading sense one part sits on the other; here the dog comes first and the garden plot second

blocks.note: a mongrel is a cross between breeds
a vegetable bed is a patch of ground

explanation.surface: A mutt sprawled on the bed infuriates its owner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bed' looks like furniture but is a garden plot.
explanation.definitionFit: A crosspatch is a grumpy, bad-tempered person, so someone who is angry.

clue.text: Wharf bird?

blocks.note: surface reading: a seabird that hangs around docks, like a gull
setter's reading: the songbird whose name goes before Wharf in a London place name

explanation.walkthrough: Canary Wharf is London's Docklands business district; the bird is the yellow songbird that names it.
explanation.definitionFit: The yellow songbird lends its name to the London financial district, so it is the bird of that wharf.

clue.text: Skill shown to notice new riot coming to a head

indicators.note: a new version of a word has its letters made over into a fresh order

blocks.note: an ad is a notice, a short advertisement
the four letters are used as they stand
a ness is a headland, a head jutting into the sea

explanation.surface: Deftness needed to spot a fresh disturbance as it comes to a climax.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming to a head' reads as an idiom for a crisis, but 'a head' is a headland, as in Loch Ness or Dungeness.
explanation.definitionFit: Adroitness is cleverness or dexterity in doing something, which is a form of skill.

clue.text: Party clothes journalist found shabby

blocks.note: a do is a party or social event
gear is informal for clothes
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A reporter turned up at a party in tatty outfits.
explanation.definitionFit: Dog-eared describes pages with turned-down corners from heavy use, hence worn and shabby.

clue.text: Lecture given at home?

blocks.note: first meaning: a formal speech delivered to an audience
second meaning: where you live, the details written on an envelope

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a talk delivered in someone's house; the question mark flags that the second sense is where you live.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun is both a formal speech and the location of a residence.

clue.text: Small joint placed before friend on board

blocks.note: S is the standard abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
the hip is a joint of the body
a mate is a friend

explanation.surface: A minor joint of meat served before a friend at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'friend' does double duty: it gives the last part and, with 'on board', is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A shipmate is a fellow sailor, a companion serving on the same vessel.

clue.text: Publicity about steeple that "reached for the sky"

indicators.note: something placed about another goes round it, so the publicity surrounds the steeple

blocks.note: an ad is a piece of publicity
a spire is the pointed top of a steeple

explanation.surface: An advertisement about a church tower that soared upward.
explanation.walkthrough: The quoted phrase seems to describe the steeple, but it is the definition: to reach for the sky is to set high goals.
explanation.definitionFit: To have aspired is to have had lofty ambitions, figuratively reaching high toward a goal.

clue.text: Started out as bedmaker, possibly

indicators.note: possibly suggests one of several arrangements, so the word before it may be ordered differently

blocks.note: the eight letters are used as they stand

explanation.surface: Someone who began their career making beds, maybe in a college or hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: To have embarked on something is to have begun it, or literally to have boarded and set off.

clue.text: Bought spilled beans

blocks.note: first meaning: went to the stores and purchased things
second meaning: informed on someone to the police, a British slang sense

explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a shopper buying a can of beans that split; in British slang, to shop someone is to betray them to the authorities.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both going out to buy goods and, colloquially, telling tales on a person to the police.

clue.text: Reduce mini-dish's distortion

indicators.note: a distortion twists something out of shape, so the letters before it are bent into a new order

blocks.note: the letters of mini and dish, ignoring the hyphen and possessive

explanation.surface: An instruction to correct the warping of a small satellite dish.
explanation.definitionFit: To diminish something is to make it smaller or less, the same as to reduce it.

clue.text: Wise men follow one supplying pictures

indicators.note: the wise men come after the one, so their letters are placed second

blocks.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
mages are wise men or magicians, like the Magi

explanation.surface: The Magi trailing a single figure who provides illustrations.
explanation.definitionFit: Images are visual representations such as photographs or paintings, so pictures.

clue.text: A blue flower

blocks.note: surface reading: a bloom with blue petals, like a cornflower
setter's reading: something that flows, a river, which Strauss called blue in his waltz

explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' is a crossword favourite for a river, read as flow-er; Johann Strauss's waltz The Blue Danube names this one.
explanation.definitionFit: The European river is famous as blue from the Strauss waltz, and any river is a thing that flows.

clue.text: Drab little girl hits back

indicators.note: hitting back reads the word for hits from right to left

blocks.note: Di is a short form of the girl's name Diana
to lam is to beat or thrash

explanation.surface: A dull small girl retaliates against someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Dismal means gloomy and dreary, which is what a drab, colourless scene feels like.

clue.text: With bottle at work, you and I produce a masterpiece

blocks.note: a magnum is a large wine bottle
op is short for opus, a musical work
you and I together are us

explanation.surface: Fuelled by wine in the office, the two of us create something great.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin for great work, the phrase means an artist's finest or most important achievement.

clue.text: Five are pointless, yet the first can change

indicators.note: a compass point is a crossword letter like E, so without one the word drops it
only the opening letter of the word before it is wanted

blocks.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
taken as written before the point is dropped
the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: A philosophical musing that five things are futile, though the first may alter.
explanation.walkthrough: E, for east, is the compass point lost from ARE.
explanation.definitionFit: To vary is to alter or differ, the intransitive sense of change.

clue.text: Various airports in Nigeria initially affected

indicators.note: initially points at the beginnings of words, so each one supplies its opening letter

blocks.note: the opening letter of each of the four words

explanation.surface: Several Nigerian airports hit by some disruption at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affected' looks like a verb meaning disrupted; it is an adjective meaning pretentious.
explanation.definitionFit: A vain person is conceited and showy, and an affected one puts on airs, so both mean pretentious.

clue.text: Bases it on getting a compact home

blocks.note: beds are bases, as in foundations or the bottom layer
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone builds their argument on finding a small flat.
explanation.walkthrough: A bedsit is a British term for a single rented room used for both sleeping and living.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedsit is a one-room rented flat, so a small, compact dwelling.

clue.text: Tests - for sex I mean - developed

indicators.note: developing something changes it into a new form, so the words before it are reworked

blocks.note: the eight letters are used as they stand

explanation.surface: A clarification that the tests in question are for gender, or a cheeky aside.
explanation.definitionFit: To examine is to inspect or scrutinise, so examines means tests or checks.
